jobs.title: Director of Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
Lead strategic planning, architecture, and operational oversight for enterprise systems and services across the College, including the ERP/SIS platform, data warehouse, reporting platforms, integrations, and related administrative systems. Serve as the lead enterprise architect for core institutional systems, partnering with academic, student services, financial, and operational departments to align technology solutions with institutional goals. Led the College through a major SaaS migration of its ERP/SIS platform, coordinating cross-functional planning, system readiness, stakeholder engagement, and operational transition. Drive business process improvement, data-informed decision-making, system reliability, and secure delivery of enterprise services.

Served as Acting Chief Technology Officer during an institutional leadership transition, providing interim oversight for technology operations, enterprise systems, and IT leadership while the College completed its search for a long-term appointment.

jobs.title: Sr Programmer/Architect
jobs.description: Led the design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of enterprise software solutions. Served as a lead technical architect, ensuring applications met institutional standards for quality, reliability, security, maintainability, and alignment with the College’s technology strategy. Mentored developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving to strengthen development practices and solution quality. Contributed to build-versus-buy evaluations, vendor software selection, implementation planning, and systems integration from request for proposal through deployment. Evaluated emerging technology trends and recommended improvements to the College’s application architecture, development practices, and technology stack.

jobs.title: Web Applications Developer
jobs.description: Developed and maintained enterprise software solutions that supported College operations, improved business processes, and enhanced access to institutional systems and data. Designed and delivered MVC.NET web applications, C# console applications, SSIS packages, and integrated solutions tailored to departmental and institutional needs. Worked closely with customers, stakeholders, and development team members in an agile environment to define requirements, refine solutions, and deliver reliable applications. Supported application quality and team development through code reviews, technology research, system setup and monitoring, training, and mentoring.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Maintained PHP applications and developed ad hoc reports using PostgreSQL and MySQL databases. Contributed to the implementation of a Laravel dashboard, unified application branding, and a reporting application to improve usability, consistency, and access to operational data.

jobs.title: Junior Web Developer
jobs.description: Maintained PHP web applications supported by Oracle databases. Researched, tested, and evaluated emerging development tools and practices, including PHP frameworks, version control systems, and front-end technologies.

jobs.title: Technology Extern
jobs.description: Provided call center and technical support for faculty, staff, and students, including computer and printer troubleshooting, software assistance, hardware repair, and workstation imaging. Delivered support both in person and over the phone while developing a foundation in customer service, technical problem-solving, and campus technology operations.

volunteer.name: Ann Arbor Give Camp
volunteer.description: A charity event focused on creating sites for non-profit organizations allowing them to get a free and easy to manage website. This year our team renovated a site for wellspringdetroit.org. We recreated their site and converted their current email system to Google apps accounts.

conferences.name: KalamazooX
conferences.description: KalamazooX is a conference that doesn't focus on new technologies and programming languages, but is a conference that is designed around complementing the other conferences by enabling attendees to boost their process, design, and communication skills.

conferences.name: Stir Trek
conferences.description: Stir Trek is a one-day conference in Columbus Ohio focused on teaching software developers the latest and greatest in technologies, techniques, and tools. Talks range from understanding JavaScript Prototypal Inheritance and Windows Azure cloud services to User Experience and Design.

conferences.name: Visual Studio Live
conferences.description: Visual Studio Live is a four-day conference held to improve technical skills and to educate IT professionals about upcoming technologies and techniques. Many of the talks are given by industry experts as well as the Microsoft product team members.

conferences.name: Fluent - The Web Platform
conferences.description: Fluent is a conference organized by O'Reilly books designed to give developers working directly with the vast growing array of web technologies. The five-day conference includes a day of in-depth tutorials, two days of keynotes, and two days of hands on training. The various events range from User Experience, Version Control Practices, and many other web technology related talks.
